description: A Sankey diagram for Microsoft Power BI that shows journeys, funnels and financial flows, and takes your data the way it already is. Who it's for Analysts tracking customer journeys and funnels. Finance teams showing income statements, cash flow, or budget against actual. Operations and service teams tracing tickets, orders or material between stages. The problem it solves Most Sankeys need a source-destination-value table built before anything draws. A funnel hides where volume actually drops off. Numbers that don't balance go unnoticed, and big diagrams turn into clutter or drop small flows silently. What you get Two input shapes: bind Source / Destination / Value, or drop up to 12 journey columns straight in. Drop-off view: the loss at each step becomes its own flow, so a funnel adds up. Compare mode: bind a budget or last period and every flow is marked up, down, unchanged or new; Insights counts the flows that disappeared. Flow integrity check: inflow against outflow at every node, a balancing node, and finance presets. Path analysis: follow one node's volume, or click to isolate a path end to end. Clutter control: Top-N with an automatic Other group and a "showing N of M" note. Insights: concentration, bottlenecks and drop-offs in plain English. Styling: four orientations, 35 palettes, patterns, icons, colour rules, node drag that survives refresh. Also: Table and…
